product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an AI marketing orchestration platform for enterprise marketing teams that helps them create and run context-rich, on-brand campaigns at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies enterprise marketing teams as the audience and describes orchestrating people, agents, and systems to run context-rich, on-brand campaigns at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The public Microsoft Marketplace listing has a dedicated Plans tab and identifies the Essentials, Teams, and Enterprise product plans; its overview also displays a starting price. This is a public pricing/plans page even though Typeface’s own website has no rate card.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company homepage’s customer testimonial section identifies J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management and ASICS as customers. | named_customers.0: The homepage customer testimonial is attributed to J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management. | named_customers.1: The homepage identifies ASICS and quotes its VP, Global Brand & Digital Innovation.

employee_band.notes: Indexed.vc lists 201–500 employees, which maps to the allowed 201-500 band. LinkedIn’s broader 51–200 range conflicts, so the exact band is uncertain.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists its primary location in Palo Alto, California. | hq_country: The company profile gives its primary location in Palo Alto, California, US, supporting United States as the headquarters country.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile identifies Typeface as founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a marketing-oriented “The Brief” organized around AI transformation, creative, and product/company news. The cited R&D-led posts announce product capabilities and the orchestration engine; the index does not show at least two distinct technical engineering posts explaining implementation, so this does not meet the stated threshold for an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains a Guides section and numerous individual connector guides, along with API and MCP documentation links.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Typeface job board lists a Senior ML Engineer role under Engineering.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI, and Stability.ai Stable Diffusion
model_provider.notes: Typeface’s platform page names OpenAI GPT-4, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI, and Stability.ai Stable Diffusion in its AI stack.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Typeface’s security FAQ explicitly states SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification; ISO/IEC 42001 is not included because it is outside the requested certification list. | compliance_certs.0: The security FAQ names SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: The security FAQ names ISO 27001 certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile labels the October 2025 round Series C. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the most recent reported Series C to October 2025, represented as 2025-10. | funding_amount_usd: The latest funding-history profile reports a $100.0 million Series C in October 2025. The amount is reported in USD; other funding trackers give inconsistent round classifications or totals, so this is the best-supported current candidate.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported latest Series C is dated October 2025, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists Enterprise Account Executive East, West, and London positions.

launched_6mo.notes: Typeface’s blog index dates the next-generation Orchestration Engine post to September 22, 2026, within the six-month window. The dated post describes the next-generation product system and its Arc Graph, Arc Fabric, and Arc Loop components, supporting a major product evolution in the window.
